archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + EDITORIAL PRECISION (Authority, Clarity, Tactile Beauty)
design_rationale: A 'Hello World' app is typically banal and empty. Here it is transformed into an exquisite typographic celebration of software genesis: mixing high-contrast Swiss editorial typography with an interactive architectural terminal canvas, interactive live greeting in multi-languages, audio/haptic click feedback illusion, and tactile dev controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font imports in frontend/src/index.css with `@import "@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk";` and `@import "@fontsource-variable/instrument-sans";` and `@import "@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono";`.

2. Configure `--font-sans: 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif;` and `--font-heading: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif;` and `--font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace;` in `@theme inline` in `frontend/src/index.css`.
3. Set `html` tag to class='dark' in `frontend/index.html` for deep rich obsidian dark mode.
4. Build the page in `frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx` (already mounted in `App.tsx`) with pure HTML + Tailwind + customized shadcn/ui components (`Button`, `Badge`, `Card`, `Sonner Toaster`).
5. Use `data-testid` attributes on every interactive element and text output.
6. Ensure no external network requests or broken backend gates are added since user specified a static Hello World page only.
7. Mount `<Toaster />` from `@/components/ui/sonner` so Sonner toasts work cleanly when user clicks 'Ping the World'.
